annotation.interpretation_a: The clause means that any ACK frame arriving in an unprotected packet *after* a 1-RTT protected packet is received is discarded, regardless of whether the 1-RTT packet contained an ACK frame itself.
annotation.interpretation_b: The clause means that any ACK frame arriving in an unprotected packet *after* a 1-RTT protected packet is received *and* the 1-RTT packet contained an ACK frame is discarded. If the 1-RTT packet did not contain an ACK frame, the unprotected ACK frame is still processed.
annotation.justification: The clause states that all ACK frames in unprotected packets *must* be discarded after a 1-RTT protected packet is received. However, it doesn't specify if the 1-RTT packet itself needs to contain an ACK frame for this rule to be triggered. This creates two reasonable interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the discarding is conditional on the 1-RTT packet *also* containing an ACK frame. The phrase 'after successful receipt of a packet protected with 1-RTT keys' does not specify whether the 1-RTT packet must also contain an ACK frame for this rule to apply.
